Lion of Fo markers show 20 possible statue sites. The Bloxodes guide has two randomized statue identities, so the map does not assign completion to any one site.

about: This page shows map locations published in GTA Wiki's current map records. Event layers are off by default because their locations are seasonal; turn on the year you need and check whether that event is active.
LS Tags uses 30 Spray Can locations. The 30 Daily Poster markers are possible rotation sites, not 30 posters that can all be collected at once.
The seven Air Freight mission Signal Jammers are not the 50 freemode Signal Jammers in the linked collection guide.

Action Figures, Playing Cards, the 50 freemode Signal Jammers, Media Sticks, Movie Props, and Peyote Plants are linked as guides but not drawn as pins because the reviewed source map records did not provide verifiable coordinates for those sets.
